description: On the bed in front of you there’s a small white drawer-unit piece in the center and a matching loose drawer piece to the right. The left hand moves in and rests on the top of the center unit to steady it as the right hand picks up the loose drawer piece, slides it left toward the opening, and pushes it straight in until it sits flush, ending with the right hand on the front knob while the left hand is still stabilizing the unit.
